svg.title: Premises and zones, day 12 (simulated)
svg.desc: Premises and zones, day 12 (simulated): schematic map of 105 premises (19 infected, 49 contact, 17 at-risk, 20 free). Rings from the infected premises (P-001, P-006, P-007, P-011, P-013, P-025, P-027, P-028, P-029, P-030): infected zone 3 km, control area 10 km, surveillance zone 20 km. Marks are sized by head count. Positions are simulated and the premises are fictional.
